text.en: From here, you see what the painting sees.

text.zh: 画中是莫奈的妻子卡米耶和他们的儿子让，正走在阿让特伊的一片草坡上。
text.en: This is Monet's wife, Camille, and their son, Jean, walking on a grassy slope in Argenteuil.

text.zh: 阳光从她身后照过来，把阳伞顶部和她身后飘动的布照得发白。
text.en: Sunlight shines from behind her, whitening the top of the parasol and the cloth flowing at her back.

text.zh: 她身前，被下面野花的颜色映上了一层黄色。
text.en: Below, the wildflowers cast a touch of yellow onto her front.

text.zh: 风好像在她周围打转，把面纱吹向右边，她面前的草却朝相反的方向吹。
text.en: The wind seems to swirl around her, blowing her veil to the right, while the grass in front of her blows the other way.

text.zh: 儿子让站在稍远处，似乎完全没有感觉到风。
text.en: Jean stands a little further back and doesn't seem to feel the wind at all.

text.zh: 这幅画是在户外画的，很可能一次就画完了，只用了几个小时。
text.en: It was painted outdoors, probably in a single session lasting a few hours.

exclusive._说明: 独家发现“白裙子里有几种颜色”：打开后显示原画，观众点卡米耶的“白色”裙子，每点一处就从图片像素读出那一小块的平均颜色，排成色块，按色相归类（蓝、黄、紫、绿……），最后列出找到了几种。不预设答案。

label.en: How many colours in a white dress?

note.zh: 这条裙子看起来是白色的，其实里面有蓝、黄、紫、绿……你找到了几种？
note.en: The dress looks white, but it holds blues, yellows, violets, greens… How many did you find?

alt.en: Claude Monet, Woman with a Parasol – Madame Monet and Her Son, 1875, National Gallery of Art, Washington

text.zh: 1871年底，在马奈的帮助下，莫奈搬到了巴黎郊区的阿让特伊。在这里，他度过了创作最丰富的时期之一。
text.en: At the end of 1871, with Manet's help, Monet moved to Argenteuil, a suburb of Paris. It began one of the most productive periods of his career.

alt.zh: 莫奈《撑阳伞的女人——莫奈夫人和她的儿子》1875年，华盛顿国家美术馆
alt.en: Claude Monet, Woman with a Parasol – Madame Monet and Her Son, 1875, National Gallery of Art, Washington

title.zh: 第二幕 · 草坡上的一刻

text.zh: 1875年，他在户外画下了妻子和儿子，很可能只用了几个小时。他想抓住的，是风吹过、阳光闪过的那一刻。
text.en: In 1875, he painted his wife and son outdoors, probably in just a few hours. What he wanted to catch was the moment the wind blew and the sunlight flashed.

alt.zh: 莫奈《撑阳伞的女人——莫奈夫人和她的儿子》1875年，华盛顿国家美术馆
alt.en: Claude Monet, Woman with a Parasol – Madame Monet and Her Son, 1875, National Gallery of Art, Washington

title.zh: 第三幕 · 像画风景一样画人
title.en: Painting a person like a landscape

text.zh: 他画卡米耶的脸，就像画周围的草和云一样自由，完全不同于当时学院派肖像的规矩。
text.en: He painted Camille's face as freely as the grass and clouds around her, quite unlike the formal rules of academic portraiture at the time.
